exorcist.name: John Doe - Gravely, Deep, and Engaging
exorcist.description: Middle aged American male accent. Voice is Intimate and warm. Perfect for audiobooks.

exorcist.name: Declan - Horror, Narrator
exorcist.description: A scary, ancient voice  like it’s speaking from a peat-dark cottage at the edge of the world. Raspy, weathered and brushed with a subtle Irish twang, it creeps into your spine like a half-forgotten nightmare. The sound of a man who has seen too much and lived to whisper warnings. Perfect for horror narration, psychological thrillers, gothic tales and dark folklore. If you want a voice that drips dread — cold, slow and spellbinding — Declan Graves delivers.

exorcist.name: Gregory Grumble - Old Lovable Bedtime Bear
exorcist.description: Gregory Grumble is a gruff but lovable old bear with a warm, gravelly voice full of character. His tone carries the weight of many winters and the coziness of crackling fires. Slightly raspy, with a slow, deliberate pacing, Gregory speaks like someone who enjoys taking his time — savoring every word like a sip of hot tea. Despite his grumbly exterior, there's a gentle kindness and dry humor in his delivery that makes listeners lean in closer. Perfect for bedtime stories.

exorcist.name: Ralf Eisend - Deep and Gravely
exorcist.description: An international audio book speaker with clear and deep voice, ideal for audio books and audibles.

exorcist.name: Matthew Schmitz - Warm Mountain Man
exorcist.description: A warm, gravelly, weathered voice, slow and measured, like a man who’s seen too many winters and knows there’s no rush. Each textured word carries weight, with a natural southern drawl, wild west tone with a bit of rasp that resonates wisdom. An ideal character for video games and storytelling. Voiced by Matthew Schmitz, a professional audiobook narrator with a large fan-base.

exorcist.name: Sekou - Deep, Rich, and Gravelly
exorcist.description: A deep voice for podcasting, audiobooks, gaming, and conversational AI in general.

exorcist.name: Sekou - Deep, Soothing and Gravelly
exorcist.description: A deep, gravelly, and soothing voice perfect for podcasts, narration, meditation, and ASMR.

exorcist.name: Gideon - Rugged, Gravelly & Northern
exorcist.description: A dramatic Northern character voice with grit, restraint, and quiet authority. Built for fantasy, games, audiobooks, historical drama, and battle-worn storytelling.

exorcist.name: James - Filipino, Warm, and Gravely
exorcist.description: A young, articulate Filipino male voice with a natural English accent. Clear, warm, and versatile, making complex topics sound approachable and compelling. Perfect for narration, educational content, advertisements, and entertainment. Well-suited for insightful discussions, film summaries, sports commentary, and more.

exorcist.name: Jay - Atmospheric, Mature and Gravelly
exorcist.description: An atmospheric and mature male voice with a classic British accent and a slight gravelly texture. Perfect for storytelling, creating mystery and intrigue. Ideal for audiobooks, documentaries, and character-driven game narration.

skeptic.name: Caty - Droll, Wry and Dry
skeptic.description: Perfect for animation or audiobooks, the vibe of this voice is “whatever.” Sarcastic, droll, and dry, she’ll entertain you with her wry humor and a side eye. She’d rather be watching paint dry or counting ceiling tiles. If you’re looking for sunshine and rainbows, you’ve come to the wrong place—try again next Tuesday.

skeptic.name: Timmy - Anxious Nerd
skeptic.description: A lovable nerdy voice with nasal tone, shy energy, stutters, and funny rambling delivery. Perfect for Social media skits, animations, gaming content, meme voices, YouTube comedy, and quirky character dialogue. Adorkable, awkward, and instantly recognizable.

skeptic.name: Jake - Serious, Deadpan, and Rich
skeptic.description: A middle aged Canadian Adventurous Man with a confident tone. Great for conversational content.

skeptic.name: Viktoria - Calm, Intimate and Sultry
skeptic.description: This voice has a subtly breathy tone with a natural mid-range pitch. There’s a hint of an unplaceable North American accent — somewhere between Southern Ontario, California, and the Midwest. The delivery leans toward deadpan with a touch of intimacy, often coming across as quietly confident. Emotion is present, but restrained, with a calm, sultry undertone. It’s expressive in its subtlety, never loud, but always commanding attention in a low-key, magnetic way.

skeptic.name: Mike - Flat, Dull and Deadpan
skeptic.description: Perfect for deadpan delivery, understated humor, and dry, matter-of-fact narrations. Movie previews and fast-food commercials.

skeptic.name: Briony - Sultry, Dry Valley Girl
skeptic.description: A female voice with a Southern California normal paced cadence. Sarcastic, sultry and a hint of that So-Cal valley girl.

skeptic.name: Drew - Deadpan Narrator
skeptic.description: American male voice. Deadpan delivery, sarcasm, vocal fry. Perfect for satirical TikTok, Reels, or YouTube narration. Ideal for creators needing dialogue for explainers, political satire, or dark comedy podcasts. This voice delivers biting commentary with little to no emotion. Includes specialized training in ironic inflections and false-start pacing.

skeptic.name: Tee - Diplomatic, Deadpan, and Clear
skeptic.description: A young male from Canada. Voice works well for youtube videos.

skeptic.name: Dr. Quibble - Nerdy Cartoon Scientist
skeptic.description: A nerdy, nasally scientist or Professor Cartoon Character voiced by professional voice actor Matthew Schmitz, perfect for animation, game, show, short videos, etc. Goofy, geek, smart, sarcastic, brainy, funny, ironic, clumsy, and unforgettable witty personality!

skeptic.name: Deadpan Cynic with a Slight Lisp
skeptic.description: Low-energy fatalist delivery with a distinctive speech pattern that makes every line more pathetic and funny. Deadpan, world-weary delivery for shopkeepers, companions, and NPCs who are tired of adventurers, tired of quests, and tired in general. Works for dark comedy, noir RPGs, or any game or show that needs a voice that treats saving the world like a tedious day job. Dry wit, cynical observations, reluctant participation -- all delivered with maximum apathy and perfect comic timing.

priest.name: James Articulose - Southern and Pious
priest.description: He is a preacher,58 years old, a religious man. He loves god a lot and loves to pray. Very outgoing and dignified in the way he speaks. he's very southern.

priest.name: Coach Dave
priest.description: Warm, authoritative, and soulful. A storyteller's voice with Southern roots without the southern slang or draw, and Alaskan experience. Deep, grounded, and unhurried — the kind of voice that makes you pull up a chair. Equal parts preacher, mentor, and father. Speaks from lived experience, not theory.

announcer.name: Hank - Deep and Engaging Narrator
announcer.description: Hank's deep, rich voice is reminiscent of famous movie trailer actors like James Earl Jones and Don LaFontaine. His voice is currently one of the top social media voices in the world.

announcer.name: Xavier - Dominating, Metalic Announcer
announcer.description: The 'Unreal Tonemanagement 2003' voice, originally voiced by Christian Plasa, is a retro-futuristic announcer style inspired by classic arena shooters. With its sharp, metallic authority, it’s ideal for domination calls, game intros, and immersive content that channels high-tech tournament energy.

announcer.name: David - Movie Trailer Narrator
announcer.description: Middle aged Male with a deep voice. Suitable for Entertainment & TV.

announcer.name: Don - Movie Trailer Narrator
announcer.description: A Deep, Epic, Powerful Movie Trailer and Documentary Voice

announcer.name: Titan - Young Epic Storyteller
announcer.description: Utilize the American, raspy yet youthful voice of Titan, a young-adult narrator whose deep, textured tone delivers gripping, edge-of-your-seat storytelling. Titan’s voice is built for suspenseful monologues, cinematic narration, and immersive audio experiences, with a natural grit that resonates in dystopian fiction, sci-fi audiobooks, and dark fantasy universes. The perfect blend of teen bravado and mature depth, Titan excels in trailer voiceovers, gaming content, and story-driven podcasts.

announcer.name: Atlas
announcer.description: Deep, powerful cinematic announcer voice with commanding authority. Perfect for movie trailers, festivals, sports events, game cinematics, TV promos and epic narration. Delivers a rich low end, dramatic intensity and premium broadcast quality. You may want to add some reverb in post.

announcer.name: Aaditya K - Deep Suspense Narrator
announcer.description: Aaditya K brings a deep baritone presence to suspense, thriller, and horror narration. His voice carries natural weight and cinematic intensity — the kind that builds dread slowly and holds attention completely. Already loved by listeners for his English AI voice, this recorded version delivers the same depth in a suspenseful tone purpose-built for storytelling. Ideal for thriller audiobooks, mystery podcasts, horror narration, cinematic trailers, and OTT content where atmosphere and vocal texture drive the experience.

announcer.name: Dark Indian Baritone Narrator
announcer.description: Deep male Indian voice for horror, documentary, storytelling, audiobooks, and trailers.

announcer.name: Chuck Fresh - Movie Trailer Narrator
announcer.description: You found it! The world famous Movie Trailer Voice character by professional voice actor Chuck Fresh, as heard in the movies, on television, and in the movies.

announcer.name: Kuya - Upbeat and Energetic
announcer.description: Kuya Boy Baskebolista is the ultimate basketball announcer—fast, loud, and full of exaggerated energy! His voice is like a Pinoy sports commentator on steroids, delivering rapid-fire play-by-plays with intense passion. Every dunk, three-pointer, and crossover is hyped to the max. His exaggerated reactions, wild catchphrases, and never-ending excitement make him perfect for sports narration, game highlights, and over-the-top commentary! "Boom! Pasok yan! Goooooal—ay, mali, basket pala!"
